title: Daily Dose #389: Use What God Has Given
body:
**“As each has received a gift, use it to serve one another.”**

Comparison can keep a useful person inactive.

We notice someone else’s confidence, opportunity or ability and decide our contribution is too small. Peter gives a different instruction: use what you have received.

Some people speak publicly. Others listen carefully, organise faithfully, give generously, welcome strangers, repair what is broken or notice those everyone else passes by. Service does not become spiritual only when it happens on a platform.

Peter calls believers stewards of God’s varied grace. A steward does not own the gift; they are trusted to use it well. That removes both pride and insecurity.

What ability, experience, time or resource has God already placed in your hands? Find one practical way to use it for someone else.

You do not need another person’s gift to obey with yours.
